purpose: Exercise the stable-individual posterior coupling contract independently of model implementation.

definitions.stable_individual_draw: One posterior hypothesis about one fixed individual, sampled from q(u_i | factual_history).
definitions.sibling_action_bundle: All required intervention branches for one individual and one stable_individual_draw_id.
definitions.epistemic_uncertainty: Posterior uncertainty over the same individual's stable characteristics.
definitions.aleatoric_uncertainty: Time-varying process/environment disturbances; shared only under explicit event correspondence.

admission_invariants: For each individual and posterior_draw_id, every required sibling action uses the same posterior_draw_digest.
Factual history, restored branch point, task, model, utility scale, seed scope and evaluation split are frozen across sibling actions.
Branch-local endogenous states may diverge after action application.
Exogenous events are coupled only when the task-specific correspondence contract admits them.
Missing or mismatched sibling branches produce UNKNOWN or REJECTED, never zero effect.
All branches and posterior draws for one individual remain in one split and one statistical cluster.

fixtures.purpose: Accept valid sibling branches with one shared stable-parameter draw.
fixtures.reason: The same individual hypothesis is used by both actions; branch-local post-action state is allowed to differ.

fixtures.purpose: Reject independently sampled stable parameters for a paired individual-effect estimate.
fixtures.reason: The branches no longer represent alternative actions for the same posterior hypothesis.

fixtures.purpose: Ensure the validator does not force identical post-action endogenous trajectories.
fixtures.reason: Stable individual parameters are shared; action-driven dynamics are distinct.

fixtures.purpose: Prevent a symmetric posterior effect distribution from being reported only as a zero mean.
fixtures.reason: A zero posterior mean hides sign ambiguity and nontrivial individual-effect magnitude.

fixtures.purpose: Do not treat stable posterior coupling as proof that stochastic events correspond.
fixtures.reason: The same hidden individual draw does not authenticate shared random events.

fixtures.purpose: Avoid inventing stochastic verifier requirements for deterministic tasks.
fixtures.reason: No stochastic correspondence proof is required where the declared task has no stochastic draw domain.

fixtures.purpose: Refuse a precise point estimate when the target lies outside posterior support or the support is unavailable.
fixtures.reason: No posterior support cannot be converted into zero uncertainty.

fixtures.purpose: Reject duplicate and incomplete sibling action coverage.
fixtures.reason: The bundle contains a duplicate action and omits a required branch.

fixtures.purpose: Reject posterior draws or sibling branches split across data partitions.
fixtures.reason: The evaluation unit is the individual with its complete branch family, not a single pair row.

fixtures.purpose: Prevent branch-specific filtering from silently substituting another stable individual draw.
fixtures.reason: Branch-local beliefs may update, but the paired sample's underlying stable-individual hypothesis remains fixed.

explicit_non_claims: No posterior inference or HDC Bayesian encoder implemented.
No DMC replication or model benchmark executed.
No physical experiment or simulator result generated.
No SOTA or resource advantage demonstrated.
Semantic fixtures test the protocol only and are not hidden empirical qualification.

prior_art_boundary.same_exogenous_u: Okita formalizes counterfactual pairs by holding the same individual-specific exogenous u and factual history fixed across interventions (Eq. 10). This is established semantics, not a PCIR novelty claim.
prior_art_boundary.abduction_posterior: Okita defines abduction as P(U | factual observations) and maps the RSSM posterior q_phi(z_t | h_t, o_t) to this role structurally; numerical correspondence between learned z and physical U is an empirical question.
prior_art_boundary.pcir_scope: An auditable Symthaea implementation/ablation protocol for explicit stable-trait posterior/sample identity versus a standard RSSM-style branch-point latent copied across sibling action branches.
prior_art_boundary.required_control: A9 standard RSSM-style posterior latent with identical branch-point deterministic/stochastic state cloned across sibling action branches.
